_readme: The 16 bingo squares, in grid order (row by row, 4 per row). ONE source: the phone page reads this file and the n8n export reads it when the workflow is rebuilt (python3 fate-bingo/build_workflow.py deploy). Edit the text freely; keep exactly 16 entries. 'short' shows on the tile, 'prompt' shows when a guest taps it. Square 1 is Josh's own example from the 2026-11-09 Content Sync.

Find someone who has at least one client running spend on Ramp.
Find someone who built a 13 week cash flow for a client this month.
Find someone who used AI to help close the books this year.
Find someone who presented in a board meeting this quarter.
Find someone who started their career at a Big 4 firm.
Find someone who has an ecommerce client.
Find someone who raised their prices this year.
Find someone who hired someone onto their team this year.
